description: This Java class `NoteService` provides business logic for managing notes, including creating, retrieving, updating, listing with pagination, and deleting notes. It interacts with a repository layer for data persistence and uses DTO classes for data transfer.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer class that encapsulates the business logic for notes management

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided request and returns a DTO of the created note.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, throwing NoSuchElementException if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notes, sorted by updatedAt in descending order.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new data provided in the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, throwing exception if not found.
